hierarchy.metric_value: font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-white tabular-nums tracking-tight

rules: All sensor values, KPIs, and timestamps MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Never center-align tabular data; always left-align labels and right-align values where appropriate, or left-align both.
Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking for industrial clarity.
Use status colors purely for functional indicators (dots, borders, chart lines), NOT for large background fills to avoid overwhelming the eye.
Use 10% opacity fills of status colors for backgrounds of alert badges (e.g., bg-red-500/10 text-red-500).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tight and dense. Use p-4 for cards, gap-4 for grids.
rules: Every widget must have h-full to stretch.
No rounded corners greater than rounded-md (4px). Sharp, precise industrial feel.
Use 1px solid borders for all cards. Avoid soft shadows.

cards.header: flex justify-between items-center pb-2 mb-4 border-b border-[#2A2D35]

status_indicator.animation: animate-pulse for Critical or Offline states

tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 border-b border-[#2A2D35] pb-2 text-left

charts.style: Use Recharts. Line charts with 1px stroke, no fill. Area charts only for baseline overlay with 10% opacity fill.

gauges.style: Minimalist radial bars or arc lines. Background arc #2A2D35, foreground arc based on status color.

micro_interactions.hover: Subtle background shifts (e.g., bg-[#111318] to bg-[#1A1D24]).
micro_interactions.data_update: Values should use tabular-nums to prevent layout shifting on tick.
micro_interactions.staleness: If a sensor is offline (last seen > X mins), text color fades to #8E8E93 and shows a small '!' icon.

rules: All interactive elements and KPI displays MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Maintain WCAG AA contrast for all text against the #111318 background.

tech_stack_guidance.files: Use .js and .jsx files for React components. Do not use .tsx or TypeScript.
tech_stack_guidance.libraries: Recharts for charts/gauges, Lucide-react or Phosphor icons for UI icons.

images.description: Industrial cooling towers on a rooftop. Use with heavy black overlay (bg-[#090A0C]/90) if used as an app background, or for auth/login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono.
Build standard pure HTML/Tailwind structures for the dashboard grid, avoiding over-reliance on generic Shadcn cards to maintain the sharp SCADA look.
Use Recharts for the power-vs-time trend chart and Recharts (RadialBar) or custom SVG for gauges.
Implement real-time updates seamlessly. Ensure numbers are contained in tabular-num spans to prevent layout shifting on tick.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide with sharp, industrial stroke weights.
